crossings.label: Pedestrian crossing delay
crossings.note: Widths, signal timings and the zebra wait are assumed

counts.label: DfT traffic counts
counts.note: Annual average daily flow, latest year. 1 of 9 counted that year; DfT estimated the rest

rules.label: Legal restrictions
rules.note: Every quote checked word for word against the cached order. Abstained clauses can't be encoded honestly, so they aren't applied

concerns.label: Consultation concerns
concerns.note: From published consultation reports, as per-street counts

designs.label: Design options
designs.note: Scored on the modelled car network; the demand levels and the closure in the scenarios are assumptions

speeds.label: Bus-observed speed
speeds.note: Speed of buses, not of all traffic. Solid where a bus was seen in that quarter-hour; dashed where the model predicts it
